notes.title: About deactivating the demo
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are temporarily deactivating our demo version on Steam. The reason for this is to fix the deficiencies identified during Next Fest and the feedback we received, as well as to provide a much higher quality experience by adding new content to the game.

We would like to thank you wholeheartedly for your support and valuable feedback during this process. We are grateful for your patience and understanding. We will be back with a stronger, more enjoyable and richer experience.

Stay tuned!

Best regards,
Kaira Digital Arts

notes.title: Isle Of Pirates Demo Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that critical game-breaking bugs have been addressed, ensuring smoother gameplay for everyone. Rest assured, we’re actively working to identify and resolve any remaining issues as quickly as possible.

Your patience and support mean the world to us as we continue improving the experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of this journey with us!
